hypotheses.claim: If score_ruin_nodes uses score_i = rank_power(|removal_savings_i|/scale * gate_load * gate_depot * gate_demand * gate_rdist, p) with p rising from ~1.2 toward ~2.5 as stagnation_ratio grows but decaying as iter_frac -> 1, and gate_load = (route_load/capacity)^2 rewards over-full routes while gate_rdist = route_dists/mean_route_dist penalizes long routes, then mean objective on cvrp_dev_hetero_24 improves versus the current SBS (15.788 mean) because tight-capacity and clustered instances are best served by re-inserting customers out of saturated routes rather than the highest absolute-savings edges.

next_search_advice.direction: Stagnation-adaptive destruction scoring: rank-power p(iter_frac, stagnation_ratio) that grows during stagnation (diversify) but shrinks near deadline (exploit), multiplied by capacity-tightness and depot-eccentricity gates to target the weakest regimes (capacity_level=tight, depot_style=eccentric, spatial=clustered).
